headline: Welcome to my online portfolio! Take a browse and if you see anything you like feel free to reach out via email!
bio: My name is Marien de Freitas, I am a self-taught acrylic painter and illustrator based in Kitchener, Ontario. I grew up in rural Manitoba so I draw a lot of my inspiration from the natural inherent beauty that resides within people and the natural world the surrounds us.
